decision: activeCompany.grants is one entry per live captured assignment: registry bundle id, assignmentId, permissionSetVersion (null only for Company Context Access) and the exact permissions of that version, in registry order; Workspace permissions stay in workspacePermissions and *Capture fences stay where they are
why: One shape that every web consumer can read (#1333) and that survives deleting the legacy fields (#1334); the registry already holds every fact

decision: The web parses grants once in apps/web/src/access/company-grants.ts against a full mirror of the registry (bundle, versions, permissions); an unknown bundle, version, permission, blank assignment or duplicate refuses the whole current Actor; grants is optional on the web until #1334
why: Fail closed on authority facts like the legacy closed versions; the production web image cannot import apps/api, so the mirror is guarded by import.meta.glob

decision: The API CompanyGrant types permissions as the union of registry permissions, not correlated per bundle; the web type is correlated per bundle and version
why: No API code reads grants; the precise type matters where #1333 consumers read it
